entities.name: Travec
entities.description: Village on Rath planeshifted to Dominaria by the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Tower of Travec
entities.description: Reed tower with a bell, destroyed by the Laccolith Titan.

entities.name: Patwog en-Vec
entities.description: Shaman-in-training who released the titan and died.

entities.name: Milgen en-Dal
entities.description: Rogue who sought power in the mountains and died.

entities.name: Laccolith Titan
entities.description: Beast released in 4206 AR that destroyed the tower and smithy.

entities.name: Retma en-Vec
entities.description: Village Oracle killed by the titan.

entities.name: Salla en-Dal
entities.description: Blacksmith and Milgen's sister who defeated the titan with the bell chain.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that made Travec part of Dominaria.

events.summary: Patwog and Milgen released a Laccolith Titan which killed them and rampaged through Travec.
events.quote: they saw and released a Laccolith Titan which killed them both

events.summary: The titan destroyed the Tower and smithy, killing Oracle Retma.
events.quote: killing the village's Oracle, Retma en-Vec

events.summary: Salla bound the titan with the bell chain and chained it to the collapsing smithy, sending both into the Rootwater.
events.quote: managed to defeat the creature by binding it

events.summary: Travec was rebuilt and became part of Dominaria with the Rathi Overlay.

relations.quote: killing the village's Oracle, Retma en-Vec
